query_alternatives.all_unordered_identity:
WITH target_CR AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT edge.src_id AS CRnode
 FROM rel_MODIFIES edge JOIN CR cr ON cr.node_id=edge.src_id
 JOIN Spec spec ON spec.node_id=edge.dst_id
 WHERE spec.specNumber='38.213'
), referencing_Agreement AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT edge.src_id AS Agreementnode
 FROM rel_REFERENCES edge JOIN target_CR t ON t.CRnode=edge.dst_id
), eligible AS (
 SELECT a.node_id,a.resolutionId
 FROM Agreement a JOIN referencing_Agreement ref ON ref.Agreementnode=a.node_id
 WHERE a.hasTBD=1
)
SELECT DISTINCT resolutionId FROM eligible ORDER BY resolutionId
